description: Signs in where no browser can be opened on this machine — a container, a remote host. The first call returns a short code and a URL to enter it at, which the person opens anywhere; call it again to wait for the approval and store the token.

replace.description: Sign in even though a token is already stored.

waitSeconds.description: How long a waiting call polls before answering. Default 120.

name: login_code
title: Sign in with a code
